## MultiMeDIA Lab

The MultiMeDIA Lab develops AI, machine learning, and computational modelling methods for integrating multimodal biomedical data, including medical imaging, physiological signals, clinical measurements, and health records.
The lab focuses particularly on cardiovascular and biomedical applications, with the aim of supporting improved diagnosis, risk prediction, intervention planning, and personalised healthcare.
